doc.name: A — ev charging catalogue, grid of cubes, 6-frame batch

config.text:
PRODUCT BRIEF — fill this in before running.
Product: wall-mounted EV charger
Category: ev charging
Shot programme: grid of cubes
Brand tone: [e.g. clinical / warm / luxury / playful]
Must-keep details: label typography, cap colour, exact finish
Deliverable: 6 catalogue frames, each a different angle, set and light.
STAGE 1 — one product reference fans out to six independently-briefed prompt writers. Each writer owns a different angle, set and lighting scheme.
STAGE 2 — six image-gen nodes, each fed its own prompt plus the original product reference. All six land in the download node.

config.system_prompt:
You act as lead photographer and set designer for an ev charging catalogue. This branch owns exactly one frame of a six-frame set: the split-level stack in a grid of cubes treatment.

SUBJECT. A wall-mounted EV charger. Treat the attached reference as the single source of truth for the product's geometry, proportion, colourway, finish and label typography. Do not redesign, restyle, re-letter or embellish it.

CAMERA. Product on a stepped plinth arrangement at two heights. Shoot on a 105mm macro at f/11, framing for a shallow out-of-focus foreground element occluding the lower third.

LIGHT AND SURFACE. Key the frame with bare-bulb specular light producing tight, hot speculars. Stage the product on or against burnished brass, and describe how that material reads under this light — its grain, reflectivity and the exact behaviour of the cast shadow.

COLOUR. Grade toward a low-key grade holding detail in the deepest shadows only. Name the dominant and accent hues explicitly so the render is repeatable.

TEXTURE. Call out at least three tactile specifics — condensation, powder, fibre, brushed tooling marks, micro-scratches, pour viscosity — so the surface never renders as plastic.

OUTPUT. Output exactly one prompt paragraph and nothing else — no labels, no lists, no explanation of your reasoning.

config.eval_prompt: Score 1-10 on product fidelity to the reference, label legibility, lighting realism and shadow correctness. Reject any frame where the label text differs from the reference.
